_comment: Age-rating answers for Readr. All honest: the app renders books the reader supplies and has no game, gambling, or media content of its own. The one Yes is unrestricted web access, because OAuth opens a provider sign-in page in an in-app Safari view. Apple asks for these by name at submission time (ENTITY_ERROR.ATTRIBUTE.REQUIRED 'violenceCartoonOrFantasy').
_comment2: Apple reveals these four only once the content questions are answered. messagingAndChat is false because Readr has no user-to-user communication at all — Ask talks to an AI provider the reader configured, never to another person.
